confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Denver pricing, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Restaurant anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation is less certain because July is peak season and rates swing with events and demand. Cocktail and wine are set relative to the local draft beer price (roughly 2x and 1.8x) because direct knowledge is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against typical US mid-sized metro tourist destinations with similar summer demand and sales tax plus lodging tax structures (for example Portland, Salt Lake City and Austin), adjusted to Denver's price level from general knowledge.
